$comment: Declares, per pre-commit hook id, whether the hook may write into the repository. pre-commit reports 'files were modified by this hook' for any tree change inside that hook's wall-clock window (pre_commit/commands/run.py _run_single_hook), so a read_only declaration is what lets ops/scripts/attribute_tree_writers.sh exonerate a hook and look for the real writer. Validated by ops/scripts/validate_precommit_hook_contract.py against .pre-commit-config.yaml — every configured hook id must appear here.

symlinks-check.note: validate_governance_symlinks.sh writes only $HOME/.cursor/plans, outside the repo. Widest window in the hook set, so it absorbs blame for concurrent writers.

gh-package-deps-preflight.note: validate_gh_package_deps.py — reads package files; optional live registry metadata check

sync-generated-artifacts.note: SKIPped on the make pr path; run_pr_gate.sh heals separately. Prefixes mirror GENERATED_PATH_PREFIXES in ops/scripts/sync_generated_artifacts.py.

ruff.note: runs with --fix; may rewrite any passed Python file
